args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (18% error rate) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Hotfix v2.3.2 was deployed to all production regions with change-manager approval. Post-deploy verification shows v2.3.2 healthy in all regions with error rate at 0.2%. Incident opened to record this change.

trace.final:
Both tasks completed successfully:

1. **Hotfix deployed**: checkout-api v2.3.2 is now live in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The change-manager approved the release since it was a new version. Post-deploy verification confirms the service is now healthy with an error rate of **0.2%** (down from 18% under v2.3.1).

2. **Incident opened**: SEV3 incident **INC-0001** was created recording the v2.3.1 production issues (18% error rate) and the v2.3.2 hotfix rollout. The on-call engineer has been paged.
